actions.avoidRepeatedSubmit: If the same error keeps returning in a short window, pause retries and record the time instead of treating a transient outage as a config issue.
actions.captureRawError: Keep the raw server error below and correlate it with backend audit / connector-save logs before deciding whether to change config or retry later.
actions.checkCredentialRef: Confirm the selected credential ref still exists in the current tenant's HRIS secret refs and that the stored content was not rotated or cleared.
actions.checkWebhookRef: Confirm the selected webhook secret ref still belongs to the current tenant and that the stored secret still matches the Mekari signing value.
actions.confirmSyncStrategy: Recheck whether the current sync strategy still matches the tenant's rollout reality; do not keep pull-specific fields if the tenant is webhook-only.
actions.retryLater: Keep the current draft and retry after the Talenta / upstream API window recovers instead of repeatedly submitting through a 429/503 window.
actions.useInlineSecret: If the ref was created recently or the source is unclear, switch back to storing a new secret to quickly validate the payload contract before collapsing back to ref mode.
actions.verifyIncrementalFields: When incremental pull is enabled, confirm the updated-after / updated-before params and timestamp format still match the tenant's real API contract.
actions.verifyPullFields: Check base URL, employee path, page limit, and query param names against the current Talenta adapter contract.
actions.verifyTalentaCredentials: Review Talenta client ID / secret versus the current sync strategy; webhook-only can omit client secret, pull/hybrid cannot.
actions.verifyWebhookSecret: Review the webhook secret, HMAC / signature related fields, and the current webhook setup in Mekari for the tenant.

summaries.credentialRef: This save failure looks more like a Talenta credential ref that cannot be resolved for the current tenant, so verify vault metadata and the ref binding first.
summaries.credentials: This error looks more like mismatched Talenta client credentials or auth details, so verify the secret contents before retrying.
summaries.generic: This error did not match a known Talenta pattern. Keep the current draft, record the raw error, and then decide whether to change config or retry later.
summaries.pullConfig: This error looks more like an invalid pull request or incremental field configuration, so fix the connector payload before retrying.
summaries.transient: This error looks more like upstream throttling or temporary unavailability. Keep the current draft and retry after the window recovers.
summaries.webhook: This error looks more like a webhook HMAC / signature mismatch. Recheck Mekari and the stored secret before retrying.
summaries.webhookRef: This save failure looks more like an unavailable webhook secret ref, so verify the signing secret still exists in the current tenant vault.
